model.title: How does the writer present the keeper's sense of duty?

parts.text: Point: the keeper puts the light before himself
Evidence: he climbed 'all ninety-nine steps, ill or well'
Technique: the list and the number
Zoom in: 'ill or well' shows nothing excuses him
Analyse: duty is routine, not drama
Link: this is why the ending moves us

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The writer presents the keeper's duty as unbreakable routine: he climbed 'all ninety-nine steps, ill or well', the phrase 'ill or well' showing that nothing excused him.
